en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a rural townscape in a valley. In the foreground stands a large, multi‑storey residential or guesthouse-style building with many windows and shutters, surrounded by a fence and open fields. Behind it stretches a small town with scattered houses, factory buildings with chimneys, a church tower, and rolling, wooded hills in the background. At the top left, in red print, is a brief title indicating the location.
